units.source_text: 这时，摇曳着的竹林子的沙沙声，盖过了流水声。

en.t: At that moment, the rustling of the swaying bamboo grove drowned out the sound of the flowing water.

units.source_text: 那里弥漫着悠悠的昏雾，似是在下雨。

en.t: A lingering dim mist filled the place, as though rain were falling.

units.source_text: 雨滴濡湿了沙洲的干燥的河滩。

en.t: Raindrops moistened the dry riverbank of the sandbar.

units.source_text: 转眼间，我头上也落下了雨滴。

en.t: In an instant, raindrops began falling over my head as well.

units.source_text: 我淋着雨，可望见的沙洲却早已不下雨了。

en.t: I was being rained on, yet the sandbar I could see had already passed out of the rain.

units.source_text: 垂钓人恢复了原样，坐在那里纹丝不动。

en.t: The fisherman returned to his former state, sitting there without moving a muscle.

units.source_text: 我头上的阵雨也过去了。

en.t: The passing shower above my head had also gone by.
